problem.title: Minimum Window Substring
facts: Every character in t, including duplicates, must appear in the selected window.
Return the shortest covering substring or an empty string.
s and t contain uppercase and lowercase English letters.

derived: need[c] tracks the remaining multiplicity deficit for character c.
missing equals the total number of required characters still missing; missing == 0 iff the window covers t.
Expected time O(|s|+|t|), auxiliary space O(distinct characters in t).
